gloss: to change; to make different; to strain (a muscle)

definitions.gloss: to change; to make different; to vary
definitions.explanation: To make something different from before or from something else: the order, the color, the seasoning.

definitions.gloss: to strain; to crick (a muscle or tendon)
definitions.explanation: In {筋|すじ}を{違|ちが}える: to wrench a muscle or tendon, especially in the neck or back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{違|ちが}える。

examples.english: It's easier to read if you write them in different colors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{毎回|まいかい}→毎回：13202_maikai⟧⟦{味付|あじつ}け→味付け：05830_ajitsuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{違|ちが}えて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Even with the same dish, I vary the seasoning slightly each time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{違|ちが}えた。
examples.english: I strained a muscle in my lower back carrying heavy luggage.
Maybe I slept wrong; when I woke up I had a crick in my neck.

notes:
The transitive counterpart of ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧ (to differ). As the second half of a compound it means 'to get wrong': ⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧ (to make a mistake), {聞|き}き{違|ちが}える (to mishear), {見違|みちが}える (to not recognize), {取|と}り{違|ちが}える (to mix up).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: transitive
- Pair: ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧ (intransitive, to differ)

WATCH OUT:
- To make a mistake is ⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧, not {違|ちが}える on its own.
- In ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{違|たが}える (to break a promise), the same kanji is read たがえる in formal writing.
